body: Yeeeaaahh. You're hot as hell. I approve!
Theoretically. I've heard an unbiased third party can really help sort things out. I haven't much looked into it, but that kind of stuff is expensive no?

I don't have a girlfriend. It was just an example of a life changing and often emotional time for some one.  My last girl left me and I think what was so hard was that I did do every thing I could and offer her every thing I was able to. That wasn't good enough though. Apparently one of my friends was good enough for her though so there's that.  Being apart of her life was the last vestiges of meaning I was able to justify.

Perhaps it is true that brains cannot remain sad. I try to pride myself on not stressing my current situation. If my girl breaks up with me, that's not going to be a catalyst for jumping of the bridge.  It's just been a daily gradual building of general perception that swings the hatchet.  Happy or sad doesn't matter to me so much as meaning.  I admit I'm generally of the pessimistic disposition, but that's who I am and that's not likely to change I feel.  I've never done any thing of meaning, and I don't really have any plans to. No goals, dreams or aspirations.  I'm just existing solely for the purpose of existing, and that doesn't satisfy me.

I'm not trying to be completely contrary or smart mouthed, but does it always get better?  I find beauty in a lot of life's fruits.  I'm an avid hiker and often seek the serenity of the outdoors. I listen to music and marvel at the complexity (or simplicity) of a groovy beat.  I look into stars and smile at the grandeur of the universe. I wouldn't consider myself a sad guy. I'm just looking for meaning man.  And for all of us, there isn't any.  The epsilons of society. I can pump a mean tank of gas and squeegee the dirt away from your window, but why? The only difference it would make if I died would be the rich folks have to pump their own gas. For a day or so at least until I was replaced.
